contexts.text: When they merely approach they begin to feel anguish.
When such come to any Society where there is mutual love... they are seized with frightful anguish.
When evil Spirits merely think of the freedom which is from affection of good and truth... they at once come into agonies.
Some... were admitted into Heaven... when they came there they began to be tortured... AC 4225:2. AC 4226. AC 8945:3. AC 9108. HH 400. SE 4700.

It is evening with the Angels when they do not perceive the Lord to be present... when they are in a state of no perception they are not affected with good, nor do they see truth as before; this distresses them, but daybreak soon comes.
They who have interior conscience are of such a character that if they act contrary to what is good and true, or to what is just and fair, they are distressed and tortured within... SE 4346.
They who are infested by mere falsities, and are not revived by truths... and yet whose life is of the truth that is of faith and of the good that is of charity, are in the greatest anguish...

When evils, that is, they who are in evils... come into this sphere which is the sphere of Heaven, they are direfully tormented, and in proportion as they enter into this sphere they feel infernal torments in themselves, and so become like those who lie in the death agony...
When heavenly loves flow into earthly loves... they induce agonies as of death.
Some from the Ultimate Heaven... were permitted to ascend to a higher Heaven... but in a little while were seized with anguish of heart so great that they did not know whether they were alive or not.
The land of straitness and of anguish = the Church where there will be no good of charity or truth of faith.
